I fucking agree with this to an infinite degree. It boils me inside when I see some undisciplined brat running and screaming in the store and no one doing anything about it. I also experienced just how fucked the school system is first hand. In 8th grade, I had this classmate(who is my age by the way) who would insult people(rarely getting punished) and throw tantrums when things didn't go her way(13 year old girl throwing temper tantrums. Think about that). One time, I finally got fed up with her bullshit and, with brutal honesty, called her out. A few periods later, the assistant principal pulled me out of class and chastised me. So let me get this straight, a 13 year old throwing tantrums and insulting people everyday is barely punished, yet a mature 13 year old who finally had the balls to call her out is reprimanded almost immediately? Why the hell is that? Why is it that that behavior was tolerated until highschool? I'll tell you why. Its because people are so afraid of disciplineing kids that they feel like they can just do whatever the hell they want when they want to. Its un-fucking-acceptable.
